A '''six-eyed aquatic species''' dwelled in bodies of [[Water/Legends|freshwater]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Such creatures were found in [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]], in the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].

==Biology and appearance==
On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="DOTC" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] territories,<ref name="EAWGG">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> a six-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] dwelled in [[Water/Legends|freshwater]] bodies, including [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]]. Their bulky bodies were covered with [[Coral/Legends|coral]]-shaped growths, and the [[Color/Legends|hue]] of their scales shifted through shades of orange and purple. They had several barbels hanging from the lower jaw and six bulging [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. These creatures had lengthy lower [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]] that did not fit in their mouths, but rather projected back close to the eyes, while the upper teeth were somewhat shorter. A long, [[Limb/Legends|leg]]-like fin protruded from the back of their body.<ref name="DOTC" />

==History==
{{Quote|Wesa goen underwater, okeyday?|Jar Jar Binks|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of {{Film|I}}, including [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks's]] meeting with [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] offered to take the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to his species' capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]],<ref name="TPM" /> located deep within Lake Paonga.<ref name="IWEI">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> With the help of the Gungans, the Jedi hoped they would be able to save Naboo from the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invading]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="TPM" /> When Binks dove into the murky water of Lake Paonga, he scared away various aquatic creatures, including one of the six-eyed species.<ref name="DOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species first appeared in ''[[Dangers of the Core]]'', a [[2000]] young-readers novel written by [[Jim Thomas]]. They were illustrated in the book by [[Boris Vallejo]].<ref name="DOTC" />
